structure_definition.name: OrgAbc123Location
structure_definition.title: Org Abc123 (Sample Hospital) Location Profile
structure_definition.description: Tenant-layer profile for org_abc123, a sample registered hospital. Narrows the India country profile (in-location) one step further: this tenant's Location record IS the registered ABDM physical healthcare facility itself (not a ward/room sub-Location under one), so the hfr-id identifier slice — optional (0..1) at the generic country layer, since not every Location under that profile is itself a registered site — is tightened to required (1..1) here. Exactly the narrowing in-location's own hfr-id comment anticipates for a tenant-layer profile of a registered site.

element.short: ABDM Health Facility Registry ID (required for this tenant's registered site)
